note: Every claim in docs/platforms that names a command, a path, a value or a status is listed here with the thing that settles it. tools/platform_claims.py re-runs them; a page may not assert what this file cannot reproduce. scope=repo means the claim must hold in any clone; scope=host means it describes THIS box and is expected to differ elsewhere (reported, never fatal).

claims.claim: the tracked commit gate is enabled by core.hooksPath=.githooks
preflight_all.py --list prints the gate table and its count, so the page can cite the command instead of a number
the production interpreter (py315t) holds a CPU-only torch build, so torch.xpu.is_available() is False there
the reference box has no reachable NVIDIA device, which is why the CUDA page is expectations rather than readings
there is no src/CORE/accelerate resolver; the ranking lives in tools/box_profile.py
box_profile.py --json reports accelerators[] and preferred_accelerator, which is the ranking port #3 is told to consume
Step 0's profile is the input to every later step, and it reports the interpreter it was taken under
psyche_fit_pams.py exits 2 and says it refuses to fit, because no construct-bearing signal exists yet
the four psyche test files the phone page tells you to run all exist
on android-aarch64 torch has no wheel, so every accelerator row must read unknown rather than unavailable
claims.refused_because: requires an Android/Termux host; no such device is attached to this box, and a desktop profile cannot stand in for one
